notes.title: Smarter loans, UI enhancements & interaction fixes | EA v0.5.0
notes.content:
💰 Dynamic Loan Interest System


Your interest rate now affects your customers and risk profile:
👥 Customer Behavior
• Lower interest = More customers, lower default rate
• Higher interest = Fewer customers, higher default rate

📉  In real banking, affordable loans mean people are more likely to repay.

🧠 Use this system to shape your strategy and maximize reach and profits.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/dcd2db16de31db2edc3ba6c795550796e8e0e1df.png"]

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements

🧾 A. Bond Interaction Fix
The last bond in the list now works properly. No more click issues or dead zones.


📋 B. My Tasks Panel
Fixed a bug where the Tasks clipboard overlapped the Manager Screen.


🖥️ C. Customization Screen UI

Improved layout and element scaling for ultra-wide (21:9) monitors.

notes.title: Extreme Banker Mode V1 | EA v0.4.0
notes.content:
🏦 Mode Selection:Financial Strategy Mode
Focus purely on financial growth, customer service, and smart decision-making.
⚠️ Forget to secure your bank? You’ll lose Bank Points.
No robbers. No weapons. Just pure strategy.
Extreme Banker Mode
Face real threats in a high-stakes environment.
You're not just managing the bank—you’re fighting to survive.



💣 New Features in Extreme Banker Mode:🌒 A. Night Robbery Event
If you forget to secure key areas (bank door, teller sections, vault) before the day ends…
Expect a surprise break-in overnight. You’ll wake up to a robbed vault and missing funds.
🛡️ B. Armored Robber Event
A dangerous robber may enter the bank during business hours. You must:
[olist]
Quietly draw your weapon by pressing R multiple times.
Hide it again anytime with Q.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/eabc11e96d69298bc525612f0f7c30f2af145e9c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/0dc0100a163c692468602c7f08279604ad7f11af.png"]

Aim for the legs – head and body are fully armored.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/98c6c46eeb869ab1b65078bad130a59caf22533a.png"]

Tie the robber with rope once they’re down.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/b00efaf63821949d0e59fee0cbf4d0560162da40.png"]

Hand them off to police outside bank [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/5ecf27b3603dac0050fd0cd28e4584e713598609.png"]
[/olist]


 🏆 5 New Achievements:
Bank Sentinel:
Protect and secure your bank for 1 consecutive day.

Bank Guardian:
Protect and secure your bank for 3 consecutive days.

Bank Protector:
Protect and secure your bank for 10 consecutive days.

Bank Champion:
Protect and secure your bank for 30 consecutive days.

Robber Catcher:
Shoot the robber in the legs, tie their hands, and hand them off to the police.


🧭 A Note From the Devs:
This is just the first phase of Extreme Banker Mode. Much more is coming soon, deeper threats, police systems, hostage scenarios, dynamic robberies, and tough psychological decisions. We released this version early to hear your suggestions and shape the future of this mode with your feedback.

notes.title: New Update - Sell Items & 2 New Languages
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the latest update packed with fantastic new features, enhancements, and critical fixes!


🛒 Sell or Return Purchased Items

You can now sell back or return items you've previously purchased. Manage your assets smarter and keep your bank optimized!

🌍 New Languages Added

We’ve introduced Hungarian 🇭🇺 and Polish 🇵🇱 language support! These were added thanks to community requests, if you'd like to see your language in the game, let us know!

Enjoy Bank Simulator in your preferred language and immerse yourself deeper into the gameplay. If you notice any translation issues, please report them in our Discord!

🔤 Improved Readability & Fonts

Unreadable words have been fixed, and overall translations and fonts have received a thorough upgrade. Your in-game experience will now be clearer and smoother.

👨‍💼 Enhanced Teller Hiring

You can now hire tellers at the same level as purchasing the Teller Office, with your first teller available at Level 10. Expand your team strategically and boost your bank’s efficiency!

💾 Save System & Performance Boost

We’ve significantly improved game saving and overall performance. Say goodbye to frustrating crashes and enjoy a more stable gaming session.

notes.title: New Update – Smarter Customers & Verification!
notes.content:
An update is now live in Bank Simulator, improving how you deal with customers and their behavior.

🔧 What’s New:
💬 NPCs Talk
 Customers now speak using chat messages or subtitles. Expect greetings, complaints, jokes, funny messages or even suspicious excuses. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/e01f1f48ffb02651a682aea262a96c2c3c6ceff2.png"]

📝 Account Verification Required
Before accepting withdrawals or deposits, you should verify the customer’s bank account.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/2e70d424194999cd30a127c1cf790a928f53574e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/5835ad65d2800f33ca75c6dc817962f92b8612bc.png"]

💸 Fake Money Can Appear Some customers may hand you fake cash, you should check money.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/e1f5d0df3d6edc8ae3ce0355b7227d5c9a6ac4cc.png"]

❗ Overdraw Attempts
You should make sure the customer has enough balance before giving them money.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/0c1d5761d9b575e46095c3b4c2782fe2527ec504.png"]

📥 Incorrect Deposits
You should double-check the amount customers say vs. what they actually give you.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309523/37b11f8e8fa402546aaca238fb77860242001940.png"]
🏦 Two Account Types

There are now Personal and Business accounts:

• Personal: Regular deposit and withdrawal amounts

• Business: Higher deposit and withdrawal amounts

This makes the deposit and withdrawal system more realistic and adds deeper gameplay when handling different customer types.

notes.title: Suggestions and bug fixing update v1
notes.content:
We’ve polished your experience with these key improvements:

🔹 Mouse Customization – Toggle "Invert Y/X Axis" in settings for your preferred aiming style.
🔹 Sharper Bond Data – Prices now show 2 decimal places for precise tracking.
🔹 Faster Loan Checks – Reduced delays when verifying loan details.
🔹 Bond Maturity Alerts – Get a clear notification when bonds are ready to cash in.
🔹 Daily Stats Fix – Corrected the 21st customer data display.
🔹 Smoother ID Checks – Interact with IDs more intuitively.
🔹 Big Screen Fix – End-day notifications now display properly on large monitors.
🔹 Cleaner Camera Motion – No more abrupt turns after closing mini games like id check or loan check

A Special Thanks ❤️
To everyone who shared feedback, we’re listening, and we’ll keep our promises. Your input shapes this game!

More exciting updates are coming… stay tuned! 🚀
